3namespace Faker\Calculator;
4
5/**
6 * Utility class for validating ISBN-10
7 */
8class Isbn
9{
10    /**
11     * @var string ISBN-10 validation pattern
12     */
13    public const PATTERN = '/^\d{9}[0-9X]$/';
14
15    /**
16     * ISBN-10 check digit
17     *
18     * @see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Standard_Book_Number#ISBN-10_check_digits
19     *
20     * @param string $input ISBN without check-digit
21     *
22     * @throws \LengthException When wrong input length passed
23     */
24    public static function checksum(string $input): string
25    {
26        // We're calculating check digit for ISBN-10
27        // so, the length of the input should be 9
28        $length = 9;
29
30        if (strlen($input) !== $length) {
31            throw new \LengthException(sprintf('Input length should be equal to %d', $length));
32        }
33
34        $digits = str_split($input);
35        array_walk(
36            $digits,
37            static function (&$digit, $position): void {
38                $digit = (10 - $position) * $digit;
39            },
40        );
41        $result = (11 - array_sum($digits) % 11) % 11;
42
43        // 10 is replaced by X
44        return ($result < 10) ? (string) $result : 'X';
45    }
46
47    /**
48     * Checks whether the provided number is a valid ISBN-10 number
49     *
50     * @param string $isbn ISBN to check
51     */
52    public static function isValid(string $isbn): bool
53    {
54        if (!preg_match(self::PATTERN, $isbn)) {
55            return false;
56        }
57
58        return self::checksum(substr($isbn, 0, -1)) === substr($isbn, -1);
59    }
60}
